newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening steady to slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening steady to slightly higher.

text.p: Wall Street shares were expected to open steady to slightly firmer on Thursday, bolstered by earnings reports following Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony on the economy.

"We are looking steady to slightly higher," Charles White, managing director of Avatar Associates, said. "Earnings reports continue to be in line or better than forecast, and the bond market continues to behave."
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index rose 1.65 points to 943.90 and the long bond rose 11/32 to 6.41 percent.
Jobless claims fell to 299,000 in the latest week.
